+"""s156_4app_boot.py — S156 wave stage-3: BOOT the 4 canonical apps on the

+  TAG in {thunderbird, tusky, nextcloud, connectbot}

+"""
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+import re
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import time
+from pathlib import Path
+
+BASE = Path("/home/z/my-project/repo")
+MA = BASE / "miniandroid"
+BIN = MA / "build/miniandroid"
+LEDGER = json.loads((BASE / "evidence/s156_4app/PIN_LEDGER.json").read_text())
+OUT = BASE / "run/s156_4app"
+EVID = BASE / "evidence/s156_4app"
+OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+EVID.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+
+DEFAULT_MAX_SECONDS = 100
+DEFAULT_FRAMES = 12
+
+NDFE_RE = re.compile(r"NoClassDefFoundError[:\s]+([\w/$.]+)")
+CNFE_RE = re.compile(r"ClassNotFoundException[:\s]+([\w/$.]+)")
+NPE_RE = re.compile(r"NullPointerException")
+UNCAUGHT_RE = re.compile(r"UNCAUGHT")
+VERDICT_RE = re.compile(r"verdict[\"'= :]+([A-Z_]{4,40})")
+STATE_RE = re.compile(r"FRAME_ANALYSIS state=(\S+)")
+
+
+def sha16(p):
+    return hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()[:16]
+
+
+def install(tag, apk, store):
+    store = Path(store)
+    marker = store / ".installed"
+    if marker.exists():
+        return "cached"
+    store.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    t0 = time.time()
+    r = subprocess.run([str(BIN), "install", str(apk), "--data-root",
+                        str(store)], capture_output=True, cwd=str(MA),
+                       timeout=600)
+    marker.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    marker.write_text(f"rc={r.returncode} t={time.time()-t0:.0f}s\n")
+    if r.returncode != 0:
+        (store.parent / "install.stderr.log").write_bytes(r.stderr[:20000])
+    return f"rc={r.returncode} t={time.time()-t0:.0f}s"
+
+
+def boot(tag, max_seconds, frames):
+    row = LEDGER["apks"][tag]
+    apk = Path("/home/z/my-project/upload/canonical_apks") / row["file"]
+    package = row["package"]
+    store = OUT / f"store_{tag}" / "data"
+    rundir = OUT / tag
+    console = OUT / f"{tag}.console.log"
+    inst = install(tag, apk, store)
+    cmd = [str(BIN), "run", "--execution-mode", "real-dalvik",
+           "--data-root", str(store), "-o", str(rundir),
+           "--max-seconds", str(max_seconds), "--frames", str(frames),
+           "--trace", "--package", package]
+    t0 = time.time()
+    killed = False
+    try:
+        with open(console, "w") as cf:
+            subprocess.run(cmd, stdout=cf, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
+                           cwd=str(MA), timeout=max_seconds + 90)
+    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
+        killed = True
+    wall = round(time.time() - t0, 1)
+    text = console.read_text(errors="replace")
+    frames_dir = rundir / "frames"
+    n_frames = len(list(frames_dir.glob("frame_*"))) if frames_dir.exists() else 0
+    shot = rundir / "screenshot.png"
+    out = {

+        "engine": "S155 main rebuild", "install": inst,
+        "cmd_max_seconds": max_seconds, "cmd_frames": frames,
+        "wall_s": wall, "process_killed": killed,
+        "n_frames_captured": n_frames,
+        "screenshot_sha16": sha16(shot) if shot.exists() else None,
+        "verdicts": list(dict.fromkeys(VERDICT_RE.findall(text)))[:6],
+        "frame_analysis_state": STATE_RE.findall(text)[-3:],
+        "uncaught": len(UNCAUGHT_RE.findall(text)),
+        "ndfe": sorted(set(NDFE_RE.findall(text)))[:12],
+        "cnfe": sorted(set(CNFE_RE.findall(text)))[:12],
+        "npe_rows": len(NPE_RE.findall(text)),
+        "console_bytes": len(text),
+    }
+    (EVID / f"BOOT_{tag}.json").write_text(json.dumps(out, indent=1))
+    print(json.dumps(out, indent=1))
+    return out

+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    tags = sys.argv[1:] or ["thunderbird", "tusky", "nextcloud", "connectbot"]
+    for t in tags:
+        boot(t, DEFAULT_MAX_SECONDS, DEFAULT_FRAMES)

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""s156_4app_pin.py — S156 wave stage-1: PIN LEDGER for the 4 canonical APKs
+(Thunderbird / Tusky / Nextcloud / ConnectBot), androguard-assisted.
+
+Zero-APK policy (§20): APKs stay in the external upload cache; this ledger
+records sha256 + manifest truth only.
+
+Output: evidence/s156_4app/PIN_LEDGER.json (+ stdout summary).
+"""
+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from androguard.core.apk import APK
+
+BASE = Path("/home/z/my-project/repo")
+APK_DIR = Path("/home/z/my-project/upload/canonical_apks")
+OUT = BASE / "evidence/s156_4app"
+OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+
+APKS = [
+    ("thunderbird", "net.thunderbird.android_33.apk"),
+    ("tusky", "com.keylesspalace.tusky_145.apk"),
+    ("nextcloud", "com.nextcloud.client_350000290.apk"),
+    ("connectbot", "org.connectbot.apk"),
+]
+
+
+def sha256_full(p):
+    h = hashlib.sha256()
+    with open(p, "rb") as f:
+        for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 20), b""):
+            h.update(chunk)
+    return h.hexdigest()
+
+
+def dex_census(a):
+    """Per-dex class counts + compose/koin marker hits (string-level scan)."""
+    census = []
+    markers = {}
+    for name in a.get_files():
+        if name.endswith(".dex") and name.count("/") <= 1:
+            try:
+                data = a.get_file(name)
+            except Exception:
+                continue
+            entry = {"dex": name, "bytes": len(data),
+                     "classes": None}
+            try:
+                from androguard.core.dex import DEX
+                d = DEX(data)
+                entry["classes"] = len(d.get_classes())
+            except Exception as e:
+                entry["error"] = str(e)[:80]
+            hits = {
+                "koin": data.count(b"Lorg/koin/"),
+                "compose": data.count(b"Landroidx/compose/"),
+                "kotlin": data.count(b"Lkotlin/"),
+            }
+            entry["markers"] = hits
+            for k, v in hits.items():
+                markers[k] = markers.get(k, 0) + v
+            census.append(entry)
+    return census, markers
+
+
+def main():
+    ledger = {"wave": "S156", "stage": "pin", "apks": {}}
+    for tag, fname in APKS:
+        p = APK_DIR / fname
+        row = {"file": fname, "exists": p.exists()}
+        if p.exists():
+            raw_head = p.read_bytes()[:4]
+            row["zip_magic_ok"] = raw_head == b"PK\x03\x04"
+            row["sha256"] = sha256_full(p)
+            row["sha16"] = row["sha256"][:16]
+            row["size_bytes"] = p.stat().st_size
+            try:
+                a = APK(str(p))
+                row["package"] = a.get_package()
+                row["versionCode"] = a.get_androidversion_code()
+                row["versionName"] = a.get_androidversion_name()
+                row["minSdk"] = a.get_min_sdk_version()
+                row["targetSdk"] = a.get_target_sdk_version()
+                row["main_activity"] = a.get_main_activity()
+                row["n_activities"] = len(a.get_activities())
+                row["n_permissions"] = len(a.get_permissions())
+                row["permissions_top"] = sorted(a.get_permissions())[:12]
+                row["libraries"] = sorted(a.get_libraries())
+                census, markers = dex_census(a)
+                row["dex_census"] = census
+                row["markers_total"] = markers
+            except Exception as e:
+                row["androguard_error"] = str(e)[:200]
+        ledger["apks"][tag] = row
+        print(f"== {tag} ==")
+        for k in ("exists", "zip_magic_ok", "sha16", "size_bytes", "package",
+                  "versionCode", "versionName", "minSdk", "targetSdk",
+                  "main_activity", "markers_total"):
+            if k in row:
+                print(f"  {k}: {row[k]}")
+    out = OUT / "PIN_LEDGER.json"
+    out.write_text(json.dumps(ledger, indent=1))
+    print("WROTE", out)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
